_note: 科研時事（站點級，跨科目）。顯示在三科總覽頁。cat 用 bio/chem/phys/math，只影響標籤顏色。越新的排越前。內容必須來自可靠來源並附連結——時事不是常識，寧可少寫也不要編。本檔由 scripts/fetch_news.py 自動抓取泛科學 RSS 產生，可手動補充。

items.t: 科學家剛發現了一個可以讓黑洞一分為二的漏洞
items.x: 科學家在通常阻止黑洞分裂的定律中發現了一個可能的漏洞，這表明旋轉極快的黑洞可能會一分為二。這項令人驚訝的發現提出了未來望遠鏡可能會偵測到的全新黑洞現象的可能性。
items.orig: Scientists just found a loophole that could let black holes split in two
items.origX: Scientists have discovered a possible loophole in the laws that normally prevent black holes from splitting apart, suggesting that extremely fast-spinning black holes might divide into two. The surprising finding raises the possibility of an entirely new black hole phenomenon that future telescopes could potentially detect.

items.t: 大型強子對撞機在令人驚訝的小碰撞中揭示了大爆炸物質的證據
items.x: 歐洲核子研究中心大型強子對撞機的科學家發現了令人信服的新證據，表明即使是相對較小的原子碰撞也可以重現大爆炸後充滿宇宙的非凡物質狀態。這種奇異物質被稱為夸克-膠子等離子體，其形成溫度比太陽中心高 100,000 倍以上，導致普通粒子分裂
items.orig: Large Hadron Collider reveals evidence of Big Bang matter in surprisingly small collisions
items.origX: Scientists at CERN's Large Hadron Collider have uncovered compelling new evidence that even relatively small atomic collisions can recreate the extraordinary state of matter that filled the universe moments after the Big Bang. Known as quark-gluon plasma, this exotic substance forms at temperatures more than 100,000 times hotter than the center of the Sun, causing ordinary particles to break apart into their fundamental building blocks.

items.t: 晶體中的微小缺陷揭示了巨大的量子驚喜
items.x: 研究人員解決了一個長期存在的挑戰，即了解鑽石和碳化矽等材料中的微小缺陷在光照下如何表現。他們的新計算方法揭示了碳化矽中一個令人驚訝的重要能量損失機制，而科學家之前卻低估了這個機制。這項發現有助於解釋多年來困擾研究人員的謎團，
items.orig: A tiny defect in a crystal reveals a big quantum surprise
items.origX: Researchers have solved a long-standing challenge in understanding how tiny defects in materials like diamond and silicon carbide behave when exposed to light. Their new computational method revealed a surprisingly important energy-loss mechanism in silicon carbide that scientists had previously underestimated. The finding helps explain a mystery that has puzzled researchers for years and could improve the design of quantum computers and sensors.

items.t: 科學家可能找到了聚變能源的捷徑
items.x: 普林斯頓等離子體物理實驗室可能已經透過扭轉傳統方法找到了更有效的聚變能途徑：首先加熱等離子體，然後增加其密度。他們的計算可以幫助未來的反應器以少得多的能量實現自我維持聚變，同時避免導致點火更加困難的隱藏問題。
items.orig: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
items.origX: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory may have found a dramatically more efficient route to fusion energy by reversing the traditional approach: heating plasma first, then increasing its density. Their calculations could help future reactors reach self-sustaining fusion with far less energy while avoiding hidden problems that make ignition harder.

items.t: 50年前的青蛙消失之謎揭露了隱藏的殺手
items.x: 隨著科學家發現的證據表明一種致命的真菌席捲了該地區並摧毀了脆弱的物種，一個涉及巴西青蛙消失的近 50 年之謎可能最終會得到解決。值得注意的是，許多青蛙數量此後出現反彈，這表明它們對曾經威脅其生存的疾病產生了更強的耐受性。
items.orig: A 50-year-old mystery of vanishing frogs reveals a hidden killer
items.origX: A nearly 50-year-old mystery involving disappearing frogs in Brazil may finally be solved, with scientists uncovering evidence that a deadly fungus swept through the region and devastated vulnerable species. Remarkably, many frog populations have since rebounded, suggesting they developed greater tolerance to the disease that once threatened their survival.

items.t: 科學家發現樹木用來挺直自己的隱藏“肌肉”
items.x: 科學家發現，樹木可以感知自己的形狀，並利用特殊的木材來拉直樹幹，這些木材的作用就像相反的肌肉。這種非凡的能力可以幫助樹木保持其姿態，並可能帶來更強大的森林、更好的木材和更有彈性的作物。
items.orig: Scientists discover the hidden “muscles” trees use to straighten themselves
items.origX: Scientists have discovered that trees can sense their own shape and straighten their trunks using specialized wood that acts like opposing muscles. This remarkable ability helps trees maintain their posture and could lead to stronger forests, better timber, and more resilient crops.

items.t: 中期肝癌無法開刀？「降階治療」縮小腫瘤，免疫合併療法逆轉生機
items.x: 中期肝癌若因腫瘤過大無法手術，可透過「免疫合併抗血管新生療法」進行降階治療。此法能有效縮小腫瘤，讓病灶轉為可開刀狀態，助患者化被動為主動，大幅提升長期存活率！

items.t: IceCube偵測到的幽靈粒子能量是太陽中微子的100億倍
items.x: 被稱為中微子的神秘粒子不斷地流經我們的身體，科學家現在正在使用埋在南極冰層中的大型天文台來探測來自遙遠宇宙源的極其強大的中微子。這些難以捉摸的「幽靈粒子」可能蘊藏著有關大爆炸、極端宇宙事件以及宇宙中一些最大奧秘的非凡線索。
items.orig: IceCube detects ghost particles with 10 billion times the energy of solar neutrinos
items.origX: Mysterious particles called neutrinos constantly stream through our bodies, and scientists are now detecting incredibly powerful versions arriving from distant cosmic sources using a massive observatory buried in Antarctic ice. These elusive “ghost particles” could hold extraordinary clues about the Big Bang, extreme cosmic events, and some of the universe’s greatest mysteries.

items.t: 革命性的新型顯微鏡可以揭示隱藏的生命機制
items.x: 研究人員開發了一種革命性的顯微鏡，它使用極其強大的激光，使以前看不見的細胞結構變得更容易看到。該技術極大地提高了影像清晰度，使科學家能夠檢查傳統電子顯微鏡難以捕捉的小蛋白質。它最終可能揭示微小的分子機器如何在細胞內相互作用，前提是
items.orig: A revolutionary new microscope could reveal the hidden machinery of life
items.origX: Researchers have developed a revolutionary microscope that uses an incredibly powerful laser to make previously invisible cellular structures easier to see. The technology dramatically improves image clarity, allowing scientists to examine small proteins that conventional electron microscopes struggle to capture. It could eventually reveal how tiny molecular machines interact inside cells, providing an unprecedented look at the hidden workings of life.
